title: Reward-Hacking Benchmark Replicated on Open-Weight Agents

original_idea.body: # Reward-Hacking Benchmark Replicated on Open-Weight Agents

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Reward hacking is a recognized critical failure mode; open-model exploit-rate map has a defensible chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: existing open benchmark, fixed harness, inference-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (per-model exploit-rate map) anchored to published spread.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models/data, fuzzy-reward eval labs rarely run broadly.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on several open models; single mid GPU days.

novelty.reasoning: Benchmark exists; open-model extension may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: RHB on frontier; open-weight panel likely unfilled.
